concept_ko: 북극의 봉합: 의복의 자수와 빛의 윤곽이 한 공연자를 잇는 드레스 리허설
historical_scope: Fictional contemporary stage artwork; no claim that the combined costume and light forms describe an actual historical sect, ceremony, or person.
overall_rule: PASS only if every ALL_OF item is visibly supported in native pixels. Any missing required component is FAIL; obscured or too small to establish is UNOBSERVABLE and cannot make an overall PASS.

keywords.ownership: One complete turtle-snake embroidered emblem on the central chest panel of the same robe worn by the single main performer.

ALL_OF.required: Exactly one recognizable embroidered tortoise in the main chest emblem, with a domed segmented shell, distinct head, four visible legs, and short tail.
Exactly one embroidered snake in that emblem, with one distinct head and a continuous sinuous body.
That snake forms a readable coil around the same tortoise; a continuous section visibly crosses or encircles the shell rather than lying alongside it.
The joined emblem is thread embroidery attached to one flat chest panel of the performer’s worn robe; it follows the textile surface and is visibly distinct from living animals or a loose accessory.

confusion_targets: A tortoise and snake merely side by side
A snake-like robe tie or cord
Generic scrollwork or a flower in place of the shell

keywords.ownership: The same single performer owns both the head-centered circular nimbus and the full-body mandorla; both are stationary stage-light forms behind her.

ALL_OF.required: One circular luminous disk or ring centered directly behind the main performer’s head, visibly limited to the head region.
One separate pointed almond-shaped luminous outline surrounds the entire performer from above the hair to below both shoes; both curved sides and top and bottom pointed cusps are visible.
The small circular head nimbus and large whole-body almond outline remain distinct forms, both aligned with and enclosing that same performer.

confusion_targets: A halo floating above the head
A plain oval, circular ring, or doorway used as full-body mandorla
Light outlines assigned to a second figure

source_provenance.used_for: Daoist robe material and the occurrence of turtle and snake motifs; museum discusses metallic thread embroidery. Specific joined staging is authored from the selected test label.
Xuanwu is documented as turtle-and-snake. Search excerpt used; direct open returned 403.
